cohort: 2299 COVID-19-negative parturients and 172 patients with confirmed diagnosis of COVID-19 who delivered between March 26 and September 30, 2020
finding: Symptomatic COVID-19 infection during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk for neonatal adverse outcomes and overall adverse outcomes compared to asymptomatic COVID-19 and COVID-19-negative parturients.
mod_finding: This study found an increased risk of neonatal adverse outcomes and overall adverse outcomes in symptomatic COVID-19 positive parturients compared to asymptomatic COVID-19 positive and COVID-19 negative parturients.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery was 39 weeks
